review.intent_summary: Enable scripted and interactive analysis of local CSV and JSON inputs with configurable settings, safe output handling, and meaningful exit codes.

criteria.criterion: The methods command lists supported analysis recipes and residual detectors.
criteria.notes: JSON output lists recipes and detectors, but default readable output omits all ten residual detectors.

criteria.criterion: Equivalent file and stdin JSON inputs produce equivalent request fingerprints and analysis semantics.
CSV supports positional or timestamped selected values, treats empty cells as missing, and rejects varying unmapped entity columns.
Settings resolve in embedded-request, settings-file, then CLI-flag precedence; bare JSON values can use CLI configuration.
Output files require explicit overwrite permission, and invalid input is distinguished from execution failure by exit status.

verification_evidence: Manual methods comparison confirmed JSON lists all ten detectors and readable output omits them.
Manual spike analysis in text and JSON modes returned exit 0, results on stdout, and empty stderr.
Manual malformed-JSON check returned exit 2, a diagnostic on stderr, and empty stdout.
Direct build_request check confirmed settings-file configuration overrides embedded configuration without CLI flags.
Manual bare-array file/stdin analysis with --season-length 7 produced identical fingerprints and equivalent complete results after excluding run IDs and runtime measurements.
remaining_gaps: Include residual detectors in readable methods output and add a regression check; the existing discovery test checks JSON output only.
